parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to get this ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The site configuration version. For sites with version management enabled, this parameter specifies the site version to which the configuration applies
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required for a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is not required for a global configuration. Valid values:

`on`: Enables the rule.

`off`: Disables the rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The content of the rule, which is a conditional expression used to match user requests. This parameter is not required for a global configuration.

To match all requests, set the value to `true`.

To match specific requests, set the value to a custom expression, such as `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en:
The bypass cache mode. Valid values:

`cache_all`: Caches all requests.

`bypass_all`: Bypasses the cache for all requests
parameters.help_zh:
设置绕过缓存模式。取值范围：
cache_all：所有请求都缓存。
bypass_all：所有请求都绕过缓存
parameters.name: bypass_cache

parameters.help_en:
The browser cache mode. Valid values:

`no_cache`: Disables browser caching.

`follow_origin`: Follows the origin server cache policy.

`override_origin`: Overrides the origin server cache policy
parameters.help_zh:
浏览器缓存模式。取值范围：
no_cache：不缓存。
follow_origin：遵循源站缓存策略。
override_origin：代替源站缓存策略
parameters.name: browser_cache_mode

parameters.help_en: The browser cache TTL, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 浏览器缓存过期时间，单位是秒
parameters.name: browser_cache_ttl

parameters.help_en:
The edge cache mode. Valid values:

`follow_origin`: Follows the origin server cache policy if one exists; otherwise, uses the default cache policy.

`no_cache`: Disables caching on the edge node.

`override_origin`: Overrides the origin server cache policy.

`follow_origin_bypass`: Follows the origin server cache policy if one exists; otherwise, the content is not cached.

`follow_origin_override`: Follows the origin server cache policy if one exists; otherwise, uses a custom edge cache TTL
parameters.help_zh:
节点缓存模式。取值范围：
follow_origin：遵循源站缓存策略（如果存在），否则使用默认缓存策略。
no_cache：不缓存。
override_origin：代替源站缓存策略。
follow_origin_bypass：遵循源站缓存策略（如果存在），否则不缓存。
follow_origin_override：遵循源站缓存策略（如果存在），否则使用自定义缓存TTL
parameters.name: edge_cache_mode

parameters.help_en: The edge cache TTL, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 节点缓存过期时间，单位是秒
parameters.name: edge_cache_ttl

parameters.help_en:
The status code cache TTL, in seconds.

You can set the cache TTL for a specific status code. For example, `404=10` caches responses with a 404 status code for 10 seconds.

You can set the cache TTL for a series of status codes, such as 4xx or 5xx. For example, `4xx=10` caches all responses that have a status code in the 4xx series for 10 seconds.

You can specify multiple status code TTLs, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
状态码缓存过期时间，单位是秒。
支持对指定状态码设置缓存过期时间，例如：404=10，表示对404状态码缓存10秒。
支持对4xx、5xx系列状态码设置缓存过期时间，例如：4xx=10，表示对400系列的所有状态码都缓存10秒。
支持对多个状态码设置缓存过期时间，状态码之间用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: edge_status_code_cache_ttl

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort query strings. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enables sorting.

`off`: Disables sorting
parameters.help_zh:
查询字符串排序，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: sort_query_string_for_cache

parameters.help_en:
The mode for processing query strings when generating a cache key. Valid values:

`ignore_all`: Ignores all query strings.

`exclude_query_string`: Excludes specified query strings.

`reserve_all`: Includes all query strings (the default).

`include_query_string`: Includes only specified query strings
parameters.help_zh:
在生成缓存键的时候，对查询字符串的处理模式。取值范围：
ignore_all：全部忽略。
exclude_query_string：删除指定查询字符串。
reserve_all：默认值，全部保留。
include_query_string：保留指定查询字符串
parameters.name: query_string_mode

parameters.help_en: The query strings to include in or exclude from the cache key. Separate multiple query strings with spaces
parameters.help_zh: 生成缓存键的时候，需要保留或者删除的查询字符串，支持输入多个值，多个值之间用空格分隔
parameters.name: query_string

parameters.help_en:
The headers to include in the cache key. Both the header names (case-insensitive) and their values are included. Separate multiple header names with spaces. The header names can contain the following characters:

Symbols: ! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ | \~

Digits: 0-9

Letters: a-z (lowercase)
parameters.help_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，加入指定的标头名称（标头名称不区分大小写）及其值，支持输入多个值，多个值之间用空格分隔。标头名称支持以下字符类型：
符号：! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ ` | ~
数字：0-9
字母：小写英文字母a-z
parameters.name: include_header

parameters.help_en:
The cookies to include in the cache key. Both the cookie names (case-insensitive) and their values are included. Separate multiple cookie names with spaces. The cookie names can contain the following characters:

Symbols: ! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ | \~

Digits: 0-9

Letters: a-z (lowercase)
parameters.help_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，加入指定的cookie名称（cookie名称不区分大小写）及其值，多个值用空格分隔。cookie名称支持以下字符类型：
符号：! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ ` | ~
数字：0-9
字母：小写英文字母a-z
parameters.name: include_cookie

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether requests bypass cache reservation nodes during an origin fetch. Valid values:

`bypass_cache_reserve`: The request bypasses cache reservation.

`eligible_for_cache_reserve`: The request is eligible for cache reservation
parameters.help_zh:
缓存保持资格。用于控制用户请求在回源的时候是否绕过缓存保持节点。取值范围：
bypass_cache_reserve：请求绕过缓存保持。
eligible_for_cache_reserve：符合缓存保持资格
parameters.name: cache_reserve_eligibility

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the headers to check for presence when generating a cache key. If a specified header is present in the request, its name (case-insensitive) is included in the cache key. To specify multiple headers, separate their names with spaces. The header names can contain the following characters:

Symbols: ! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ | \~

Digits: 0-9

Letters: a-z (lowercase)
parameters.help_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，检查指定的标头是否存在，如果存在，则在缓存键中加入标头名称（标头名称不区分大小写）。支持输入多个标头名称，多个值之间用空格分隔。标头名称支持以下字符类型：
符号：! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ ` | ~
数字：0-9
字母：小写英文字母a-z
parameters.name: check_presence_header

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the cookies to check for presence when generating a cache key. If a specified cookie is present in the request, its name (case-insensitive) is included in the cache key. To specify multiple cookies, separate their names with spaces. The cookie names can contain the following characters:

Symbols: ! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ | \~

Digits: 0-9

Letters: a-z (lowercase)
parameters.help_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，检查指定的cookie是否存在，如果存在，则在缓存键中加入cookie名称（cookie名称不区分大小写）。支持输入多个cookie名称，多个值之间用空格分隔。cookie名称支持以下字符类型：
符号：! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ ` | ~
数字：0-9
字母：小写英文字母a-z
parameters.name: check_presence_cookie

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the client device type in the cache key. Valid values:

`on`: Includes the client device type.

`off`: Does not include the client device type
parameters.help_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，加入客户端设备类型。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: user_device_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the client's geographic location in the cache key. Valid values:

`on`: Includes the geographic location.

`off`: Does not include the geographic location
parameters.help_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，加入客户端地理位置。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: user_geo

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the client's language in the cache key. Valid values:

`on`: Includes the language.

`off`: Does not include the language
parameters.help_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，加入客户端语言类型。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: user_language

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to serve stale content. If enabled, an edge node can serve stale (expired) content when the origin server is unavailable. Valid values:

`on`: Enables serving stale content.

`off`: Disables serving stale content
parameters.help_zh:
响应过期缓存。开启之后，在源服务器不可用的情况下，节点依然可以使用已缓存的过期文件响应用户请求。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: serve_stale

parameters.help_en:
Specifies additional ports on which caching is enabled.

Valid values: 8880, 2052, 2082, 2086, 2095, 2053, 2083, 2087, and 2096.

You can specify multiple ports, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
在指定端口上开启缓存功能。
取值范围：8880、2052、2082、2086、2095、2053、2083、2087、2096
支持配置多个端口，不同端口间使用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: additional_cacheable_ports

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable cache deception defense. This feature helps defend against web cache deception attacks. When this feature is enabled, only content that passes validation is cached. Valid values:

`on`: Enables the defense.

`off`: Disables the defense
parameters.help_zh:
缓存欺骗防御。用于防御Web缓存欺骗攻击，通过校验的缓存内容才会被缓存下来。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: cache_deception_armor

parameters.help_en: The execution order of the rule. A smaller number indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable POST request caching
parameters.help_zh: Post缓存功能开关
parameters.name: post_cache

parameters.help_en: The size limit for the request body when using POST request caching, in KB. Supported values range from 1 to 8. If unspecified, the default is 8 KB
parameters.help_zh: Post缓存对Body大小限制，值为数字，单位是KB，支持1～8KB大小的Body，值为空的时候，默认按8KB生效
parameters.name: post_body_size_limit

parameters.help_en:
Specifies how to process the request body when generating a cache key for POST requests. The following modes are supported:

`md5`: Calculates the MD5 hash of the request body and adds the hash value to the cache key.

`ignore`: Ignores the request body when the cache key is generated
parameters.help_zh:
Post缓存对缓存键的处理模式，支持以下两种模式：
md5：先对 Body 内容取 MD5，然后将 MD5 值加入缓存键
ignore：在缓存键中忽略 Body 内容
parameters.name: post_body_cache_key
